title: Zenith Creamy Irish Mushroom Risotto
description: A rich and creamy Irish dish featuring sherry and shio-cure, with a focus on ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients for a balanced meal. This recipe combines fatty and light elements for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm throughout the cooking process.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of Irish butter over medium heat and saute the mixed mushrooms until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the shio-cure and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in butter and slightly toasted.
Add the sherry wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add 1/2 cup of warm chicken broth to the skillet and stir until mostly absorbed, then repeat this process, adding the broth in 1/2 cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the risotto with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the risotto hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and a pat of Irish butter on top.
